# Roadmap: Cloud Engineer

## Role overview

Builds and manages infrastructure on AWS, Azure or GCP.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 1+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Linux & Shell](../topics/linux.md)

## Also useful

[AWS](../topics/aws.md)

## Also needed

Python, HCL, JSON/YAML, Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, CDK, Azure, Google Cloud, CLI tools

## Where it leads

Grow: Cloud Architect, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) · Lead: Engineering Manager · Pivot: Cloud Security Engineer, FinOps Engineer / Analyst, AI Infrastructure / LLMOps Engineer
